## 1. Prediction market

In the [winner contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election), in the confirmed reading of September 12 at 1:10 PM BRT, Flávio Bolsonaro is at **49.95%** (USD 10.47M) and Lula at **48.50%** (USD 10.81M), against 53.95% and 42.50% in the confirmed reading of September 11. The total volume accumulated in the presidential book adds up to **USD 148.77M**, and the distance between the two went from 11.45pp to **1.45pp**.

The move cancels and reverses that of the two previous days, when the [gap](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) had widened from 6.25pp to 9.35pp and then to 11.45pp.

Neither price is an extreme: the 49.95% sits 5.15pp below the peak of Flávio's series, of 55.10% on September 10, and the 48.50% sits 19.00pp below Lula's peak, of 67.50% on August 16. The one marking an extreme is [Ronaldo Caiado](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election), with **0.15%** in the winner contract, below the floor of the series opened on April 14, which was 0.20% on September 4.

In the [third-place contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-3rd-place) the favourite widened his lead: Augusto Cury rose 2.90pp, to **55.80%** (USD 173 thousand), 4.50pp below his own peak, of 60.30% on September 4, and Renan Santos fell 1.50pp, to **37.00%** (USD 299 thousand). Caiado rose 3.00pp there, to **8.00%** (USD 119 thousand). The [second-place contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-2nd-place) publishes no new price, because the capture lock's two readings disagreed by 0.75pp.

The [contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment](https://polymarket.com/event/any-brazil-stf-justice-removed-by-impeachment-before-2027) before 2027 gave back 1.60pp and stands at **6.70%** (USD 90 thousand), 19.40pp below the peak of the series, of 26.10% recorded on September 11. In the [Senate](https://polymarket.com/event/next-brazil-senate-election-most-seats-won), Partido Liberal rose 1.00pp and stands at **84.00%** (USD 261 thousand).

## 2. What the pollsters registered

The national poll that enters is the [Datafolha released on September 11](https://news.google.?oc=5), fieldwork from September 8 to 10, 2,002 face-to-face interviews, a margin of 2.0 points and registration BR-01833/2026 with the [TSE](https://divulgacandcontas.tse.jus.br/divulga/). In the first round it measures Lula **39%** and Flávio Bolsonaro **35%**, with Cury at 6%, Caiado at 4%, Renan Santos at 3% and Zema at 2%.

In the [runoff pairing Lula comes out ahead by 46% to 44%](https://news.google.?oc=5), and there had been eight straight national polls since September 6 in which he did not. The 2-point difference fits inside a margin of 2.0, so the pollster measures a technical tie. In the other four pairings Lula wins them all, and in three of them the distance falls outside the margin, one of them 48% to 37% against Renan Santos. The round also measures [46% rejection for each of the top two](https://news.google.?oc=5) and [75% of voters who say they have decided](https://g1.globo.com/politica/eleicoes/2026/noticia/2026/09/11/datafolha-decisao-de-voto-presidente-11-setembro.ghtml). The [TSE registry](https://divulgacandcontas.tse.jus.br/divulga/) still holds 879 presidential polls.

## 3. What the press covered

The act of the day is procedural, not substantive. Edson Fachin [denied Alexandre de Moraes's request to try in a single proceeding](https://www.cartacapital.com.br/justica/fachin-nega-pedido-de-julgamento-unificado-de-mendonca-e-moraes-no-caso-master/) the cases involving Moraes himself and André Mendonça, kept the session of September 15 and [scheduled a second one for September 23](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/republica/fachin-decide-nao-julgar-moraes-e-mendonca-juntos-acoes-do-relator-do-master-serao-analisadas-em-23-de-setembro/). Moraes had argued there was a risk of contradictory decisions. The two sources disagree on what exactly enters the September 23 session, and for that reason this page records the scheduling of the date and not its object.

On the eve of the September 15 session, Gilmar Mendes [reinforced Cristiano Zanin's request for access to the contents of Daniel Vorcaro's mobile phone](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/09/12/gilmar-reforca-pedido-de-zanin-para-ter-acesso-a-conteudo-do-celular-de-vorcaro.ghtml) and [asked that Fachin call in the Federal Police should Mendonça not hand the material over](https://g1.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/09/12/gilmar-reforca-pedido-de-acesso-a-todo-conteudo-do-celular-de-vorcaro-e-solicita-a-fachin-que-acione-pf-caso-mendonca-nao-repasse.ghtml), a request the [Estadão also recorded](https://www.estadao.com.br/politica/gilmar-reforca-pedido-de-zanin-por-acesso-a-dados-brutos-do-celular-de-vorcaro/).

Allies of the top two candidates [spoke of stability](https://news.google.?oc=5) despite the crisis in the Supreme Court.

## 4. Divergences of the day

> **The book moved ten points and the ballot moved none.** Between the confirmed readings of September 11 and 12 the gap went from 11.45pp to 1.45pp. In the same interval, [Datafolha](https://divulgacandcontas.tse.jus.br/divulga/) repeated exactly the pairing it had already measured on September 3, 46% to 44%. Price is the probability of winning the election and a poll is voting intention, and AFOS does not subtract one from the other. What is recorded is that one instrument moves in hours and the other, at the same house, has been still for nine days.

> **It is the first round of the window in which the two agree on the size.** The [book](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) marks a distance of 1.45pp and the pollster measures 2 points in the direct pairing, and both fit inside the poll's margin of 2.0. In the previous rounds the book marked 11.45pp against the same 2 points. The convergence is about the distance, not about who wins, and it does not make either of them more certain.

> **Today's shake is not rare this month, and that is measurement, not impression.** Over 147 pairs of consecutive days in the series recorded since April 14, the gap moved ten points or more in three of them, and two of those are September 7 to 8 and September 9 to 10. The [Supreme Court contract](https://polymarket.com/event/any-brazil-stf-justice-removed-by-impeachment-before-2027) gave back 1.60pp on the same day Fachin split the trial. The order of events is measured, the link between them is not.

## In summary

**The gap in the winner contract closed ten points between two confirmed readings, and neither price is an extreme of the series.** Flávio Bolsonaro is at 49.95%, 5.15pp below his own peak, and Lula at 48.50%, 19.00pp below his. The one marking an extreme is [Ronaldo Caiado](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election), with 0.15% in the winner contract, below the floor of the series opened on April 14.

**The poll that enters breaks a run of eight and measures a technical tie, not a turnaround.** In [Datafolha](https://divulgacandcontas.tse.jus.br/divulga/), Lula comes out ahead by 46% to 44%, a difference that fits inside the margin of 2.0, and the same house had 46% to 44% on September 3 and 47% to 43% on August 21.

**The Supreme Court separated what Moraes wanted joined, and set two dates before the first round.** The September 15 session stands and a second one was scheduled for September 23. Next week brings six national polls between September 14 and 16, none of them confirmed.
